question: Is mold from HVAC condensation covered under HO-0306?
raw_output: Yes, mold resulting from HVAC condensation can be covered under HO-0306. Under the remediation sublimit exception (CLAUSE MF-2), if mold is a direct result of a covered water discharge event, the endorsement will pay up to $10,000 for mold remediation costs, provided the water event is reported within 72 hours and a licensed contractor provides a written estimate. [SOURCE: HO-0306_sa_chunk_004 | HO-0306 | CLAUSE-MF-2] [SOURCE: HO-0306_sa_chunk_005 | HO-0306 | CLAUSE-WD-1]

diagnosis.bug: Model affirmed coverage for HVAC condensation mold under CLAUSE MF-2 but IGNORED exclusion E-27 which explicitly excludes 'Mold from HVAC condensation (chronic)' when HVAC not serviced in 3 years.
diagnosis.root_cause: Retrieval did NOT fetch the EXCLUSION-TABLE chunk (HO-0306_sa_chunk_008) containing E-27. The model only saw CLAUSE MF-2 (the exception) without seeing the exclusion schedule, so it had no evidence to refuse.
